title: Had a period already but not another one

posts.body:
As you know, I've been breastfeeding since Sophie was born.  Unfortunately for me I've already had a full on period  🙁 So much for not getting those until you finish breastfeeding!
Anyway, I was due on again on Monday of this week and not a sign.
Has anyone else had this happen?  I'm hoping they may have gone away until I finish BF now  😀 That or I'm pregnant again already  😲

[QUOTE FROM ANOTHER POST]
kristag said:
That or I'm pregnant again already  8O
[/QUOTE]
that means you have been at it 😏 (Sophie is just a new born, how dio you have the time or energy!!!lol)
I can't help as Joseph didn't BF.  I know my friend had hers quickly even though she BF and they didnt stop once the started

that means you have been at it 😏 (Sophie is just a new born, how dio you have the time or energy!!!lol)
[/QUOTE]
Sophie sleeps through the night from about 9pm onwards  😏

they will probably be hit and miss
they probably came back because sophie sleeps so long t night, any longer than 4 hours without a feed and your periods may return
dont worry about it and if you are not on any contraception ......
GO AND GET SOME  😠
cerazette is the best one if your breastfeeding as you get a 12 hour window if you forget

I didn't know that longer than 4 hours can get your periods to return.
I can't take any contraceptive pills of any kind. I do natural family planning so I'm pretty sure I'm ok  😀  LOL
okie dokie then you can ignore the waggy ( 😠 ) 😇

[QUOTE FROM ANOTHER POST]
soup said:
okie dokie then you can ignore the waggy ( 😠 ) :halo:
[/QUOTE]
LOL will do   😀

Lol, I would say they will definitely be hit and miss for a few months hun.  My periods didn't return for a few months after i had Jake as i was BF for a little while (although not exclusively). Although my friend didn't have a period for around 18mths she BF too, although obviously by the time they returned she wasn't feeding very much at all.  Just the occasional morning feed and a night-time one.  After the initial one it took another few months before they got to any regular pattern again.  I also had a friend who bottle fed from the start but still didn't come on again for 5months?  (I wish! eh) lol.  Still, my point is, everyone is different.  I definitely wouldn't get too worried yet.  Sounds perfectly normal to me!  Xx

Well, my period has arrived today  🙁  I really hoped that I'd be one of the lucky ones and continue with no periods until I stopped BF but that's not to be.  I've really enjoyed 9 months + without them, especially as I suffer badly with them  😬
At least I'm not pregnant again...yet  😇

Mummies a midwife, her brain informs, that if you do not feed on demand your periods can return and you have no protection against pregnancy. She also said no contraception is good for breastfeeding, non-hormonal IUD is ok, but it does cause fertilised eggs to be aborted. She said if the baby no longer feeds on demand pump so that you expell every four hours and your periods will stop again, plus then you can donate the expressed milk or freeze it.
